info.title: fjord-indexer — index a .NET solution into a Fjord database
info.description:
Index a .NET solution into a Fjord database — Buildalyzer and Roslyn over a real
      checkout, writing the predicates schemas/dotnet.sigla declares.

options.name: --sln
options.description: a .sln or .slnx to index; repeatable

options.name: --project
options.description:
a .csproj to index; repeatable
(name at least one of --sln or --project)

options.name: --root
options.description:
paths are reported relative to this (default: the single
input's own directory; required if more than one is named)

options.name: --schema
options.description:
a composed schema (`fjord schema compose`) to create any
database this run needs and does not find

options.name: --dotnet
options.description: the dotnet host to build with (default: <root>/.dotnet/dotnet if present)

options.name: --at
options.description:
where to write: [where//]name[@instance]
(default: code, on /tmp/fjord.sock — a bare name means
that socket, `box:7280//code` means TCP, and
`/run/fjord.sock//code` names a socket)

options.name: --batch
options.description: facts per block (default: 4096)

options.name: --max-files
options.description: stop after n source files

options.name: --max-projects
options.description: stop after n projects

options.name: --jobs
options.description: builds, and files walked, at once (default: 4, or fewer cores)

options.name: --writers
options.description:
concurrent write streams, one connection each
(default: 8; `--emit` forces 1)

options.name: --no-refs
options.description: declarations only: no cross-references

options.name: --no-lines
options.description: do not write the line table (src.FileLine)

options.name: --styles
options.description: also write syntax highlighting (src.FileLineStyles)

options.name: --framework
options.description:
index only this target framework (default: one database
per framework the checkout compiles for, named <at>#<tfm>)

options.name: --configuration
options.description:
the configuration this index is resolved against, recorded
as config.Setting (default: Debug)

options.name: --strict
options.description: a project or target left out fails the run

options.name: --list-frameworks
options.description: print the frameworks this checkout compiles for, and stop

options.name: --repo
options.description: the repository this checkout is of, per file

options.name: --revision
options.description: the revision indexed (both, or neither: src.FileOrigin)

options.name: --no-docs
options.description: do not read doc comments (codemarkup.SymbolInfo.doc)

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: do not let the design-time build restore first

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: index and encode, but connect to nothing

options.name: --emit
options.description: also write every block to a file

options.name: --no-smoke
options.description: do not query the index afterwards

options.name: --verbose
options.description: let MSBuild's output through
